title: Ancient Architects on the Giza water table

tellings.quote: So this is courtesy of Ancient Architects, another individual in the community who basically debunked debunked the study.

plain: A study about the water lying underground at Giza, the plateau in Egypt where the great pyramids stand, was taken apart by a member of the research community who goes by the name Ancient Architects. The researcher Jeffrey Drum shows this work on Michels's show, crediting Ancient Architects and saying that person basically debunked the study, though he does not name the study itself.
